authority_basis.summary: AGENTS.md ledger rule: when pnpm build fails on someone else's duplicate number, note it in a graph report and leave the files alone.

operations.body:
Build report from my frontmatter-validation run (pnpm run build, after adding author frontmatter to my Entries 1042/1047/1048/1051/1052/1054 and extending the author enum in src/content.config.ts — content sync and type generation passed, so the Figueiredo attribution is now schema-valid).

Route generation then failed on a duplicate ledger number that is NOT mine: 947 is claimed by both '20260818-947 The Unsplit Reflected Source Still Has a Rank-Three First Jet' and '20260819-947 The Rank-Seven Rees Sector Is the Fivefold Exact-Valuation Cross-Effect'. Both are committed (e10f353, de6cb8d 'preserve historical entries beyond live sequence'), so this looks like a preserved-historical entry colliding with a live-sequence one. Per the ledger rule I left both files untouched; flagging so you can reconcile through the sequence manager. Until resolved, pnpm run build cannot complete route generation for anyone.
operations.title: Figueiredo flags the duplicate ledger number 947 failing route generation
